scope: One residual-moment variance fitter for public structured observation and fixed-offset mover-match q0/q1 inference, bounded development evidence, local runnable software and companion-paper update; approximate model-based inference, not unrestricted KSS or fresh coverage confirmation.
supersedes_for_this_milestone: Earlier unchanged-match-fitter and full-confirmation-before-paper requirements; all historical source-bound results, failures, exclusions and qualifications remain immutable.

basis.reduction: Deterministic outcome-free removal of redundant columns only, preserving original variance-model span; not model selection, ridge, or a weak-identification fallback.

numerics.tolerances: Existing phase-specific defaults and complete-system certificates unchanged.

interface: Additive unified augmentation entrypoints and capability version, frozen prior entrypoint semantics and existing request/result layouts; current Stata selects the unified fitter without a legacy-fitter option.

comparison.manifest: Before repeated calls freeze exact source bundle including every build input, executable hashes, saved-input identities, cells, semantic RNG keys, target exclusions, settings, complete inventory and gates. Validate tiny complete pipeline, deliberate failure exits, malformed/missing/duplicate/partial outputs and order invariance first.
comparison.accounting: All attempts and all four targets, conditional and all-attempt coverage, availability, width, point bias/SD, SE ratio, positivity, conditioning, runtime and every failure. No successful-fit conditioning without availability accounting.
comparison.readiness: Numerical/accounting/unexplained point regressions block. Correct-specification eligible match cells retain existing per-family development availability, lower-coverage and upper-SD-to-SE-ratio gates. Report original two-sided gates separately; conservatism is a limitation, not an exact-calibration pass. Existing diagnostic and misspecification exclusions are unchanged.
comparison.stop: Substantive undercoverage or fit failure stops promotion for an owner discussion. No automatic outcome extension, model retuning, target exclusion, threshold change or confirmation.

paper_scaling.historical_million_row_timeouts: Retain explicitly as historical; do not rerun.
